title: Ines Vale
description: Photographs of fleeting places, quiet emotions, and everything we almost miss. Fine-art and editorial photography portfolio of Ines Vale.

sections.title: Header & Navigation
sections.summary: 3-zone layout with animated viewfinder calibration rule, uppercase wordmark, section anchors, and inquiry shortcut. Includes accessible mobile menu sheet.

sections.title: Hero Stage (The Beauty Between Moments)
sections.summary: Interactive shutter-wipe carousel with directional curtain transitions, contact sheet quick-selector, camera equipment tags, and keyboard arrow controls.

sections.title: Selected Stories
sections.summary: Curated project stories with monograph slide-out drawer reader for deep essays and high-resolution photo plates.

sections.title: Archival Gallery
sections.summary: Category-filtered photographic archive (All, Portraits, Places, Architecture, Details) with plate numbers and fullscreen archival lightbox with keyboard navigation.

sections.title: A Closer Look
sections.summary: Sticky 3-step editorial process study (Observe, Wait, Remember) exploring light, timing, and memory.

sections.title: Artist Monograph
sections.summary: Biographical introduction to Ines Vale, darkroom principles, and studio representation.

sections.title: Field Notes
sections.summary: Dispatches and journal observations from field expeditions.

sections.title: Inquire & Acquisition
sections.summary: Accessible commission inquiry form with instant client validation and mailto link generation.
